Xiao Zhang takes a look and answers, "It looks really good, but I usually don't buy these." Xiao Li continues, "You should try it, next time I take you there, changing the style is always good." Xiao Zhang does not respond obviously, just smiles and continues to do his own thing.

[Question]
If there is, which sentence is inappropriate?
